issues.text: Stock page has a leftover generic English 'Items' block (Invoice 1042, Purchase order 1041, 'In progress', 'Add item', 'Edit/Delete') that clashes with the French robot-workshop UI and uses placeholder-like data.
Very small, low-contrast secondary text (KPI captions, filter labels, 'Pour atteindre…' hints, badge text, bar tracks) is hard to read at both viewports.

Robot cards: progress bars for Énergie, Capteurs and Contrôle are empty or barely visible while scores are 12-46, so the bars look broken. Card heights are uneven and cut off at the fold, with big empty space in the R-06 card.
At 1280 the content is a narrow centered column with wide side margins and the 1440 view shrinks everything, so the width is not used well. Stock page has a large empty area under the alerts column.

Data inconsistencies: the R-06 score is 6 at 1280 and 5 at 1440, R-05 is 15 vs 12, R-04 is 21 vs 17. The R-03 card shows a P2 badge, score 0 and a 'P3 Fiable' note, which is confusing. Score 0 on R-02 and R-01 with high component values looks wrong.
The R-03 'En pause' badge and the P2 pill stack awkwardly around the ring, and the ring is not aligned with the other cards, so the paused state is not clear.

critic.summary: The Kaminos UI is coherent and domain-realistic, with a clear title, a primary CTA and KPI cards. It is let down by the stray English 'Items' placeholder section on Stock, inconsistent scores, empty progress bars, tiny text and uneven card layout.
